limitations: Nix evaluation, dependency/source preparation, the upfront source build of the manifest helper, installation and untimed validation are excluded. This is not an end-to-end speedup.
Debug/optimization levels match (0/0); Cargo incremental compilation remains enabled, and other driver defaults can differ.
Other checks ran on the shared host; load averages and resource metrics are retained. Timing differences are descriptive, not accepted budgets.
The nonempty-mode Nix argument guard was added after measurement began; its pre-guard expression fingerprint is retained here.
The immutable configuration predates the target/CPU/sysroot/PGO qualification additions. No production cutover.
scope: Repeated compile-loop comparison after supplying the upstream manifest extractor as a Nix-built executable
